description: In front of you on the bed are a small gray lid with a red strawberry on it, a clear plastic container to the right, and nearby a yellow banana and a couple of small packets. The left hand moves from the left toward the center, reaches over the gray lid to grasp the strawberry as a left-hand object, lifts it up and carries it rightward, then lowers and releases it into the clear plastic container while the right hand stays open nearby without touching anything.
